simple.meaning: זָעֵף (zâʻêph) is a Hebrew object word meaning “angry.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

timeline.evidenceText: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him; for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
